summary: Checks pass (build, vet, test exit 0). Review found the new pull_request trigger in .github/workflows/evals-model.yml runs the PR branch's own ./evals/run-experiment.sh with OPENROUTER_API_KEY, FOREST_EVAL_JUDGE_API_KEY, and Langfuse credentials in the environment. A same-repository PR can modify the executed eval scripts and exfiltrate those API keys; the prior workflow ran only on workflow_dispatch. Additionally docs/evaluation-strategy.md claims pull-request CI runs the no-model fast tier (evals/run-fast.sh) but the workflow actually runs the live-model paired tier (evals/run-experiment.sh). Promotion gate also does not verify the planned case count against the produced report, so silently missing Harbor cases are not caught. Requested changes: do not run PR-authored code with live API secrets, and reconcile the PR tier with the documented no-model tier.
